MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The solder-seal connectors felt useful because they add sealed wire repairs to what I can already do with my crimp connector assortment.",
    "The adhesive-lined heat shrink tubing felt like a natural companion to my existing connectors because it helps insulate and protect those connections."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heavy cable lugs, nuts and washers require particular cable or fastener sizes that I have no current reason to use.",
    "Owning an inspection camera or handtruck does not mean I currently need a communications cable tracer or replacement casters.",
    "The T-tap connectors overlap with supplies I already own without addressing a branch-wire job, while the cleaner and fifty cutting wheels lack a clear task for me right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair-supply purchases seemed to be treated as interest in almost any maintenance tool or hardware assortment.",
    "My connector purchase seemed to suggest that all electrical connectors would be useful, regardless of their size, purpose or overlap with what I already have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more interested in supplies that add a useful finishing or protection step to work my existing tools and connectors support.",
    "I choose specialized tools and size-specific parts when a particular job calls for them; a loosely related past purchase is not enough.",
    "My purchases are spread across years, so an older purchase does not establish that the same project is active now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests, but only a few offered a clear complementary use instead of assuming another specialized project."
}
